name: shaft
description: Language intelligence, compiler diagnostics, formatting, and editing support for Shaft.

shaft.languageServer.serverPath.description: Optional language-server executable override. By default the bundled Shaft language server runs with Node.js (node must be on PATH).

shaft.languageServer.compilerPath.description: Optional absolute shaftc executable for live diagnostics. When empty, uses the installer registration if available.

shaft.languageServer.ollamaEnabled.description: Add local Ollama suggestions to Shaft completion when the configured model is available.

shaft.languageServer.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model tag used for AI-assisted completion.

shaft.languageServer.ollamaUrl.description: Base URL for the local Ollama API.

scripts.check: node --check extension.cjs && node --check server/shaft-lsp.cjs && node --check server/lib/shaft-language.cjs && node --check server/lib/compiler-discovery.cjs && node --check server/lib/extension-settings.cjs && node --check server/lib/server-command.cjs && npm test
